what: Approve latency and copy.source on the deployed API right after batch 1 (#100, main e4cefa5) went live: copy-ahead at startup, template fallback when the background BigQuery call stalled. Three wall-clock samples.
measured_at: about 08:00 IST, after the main run (verify, live-test, deploy, smoke) finished

method.visitor: a fresh X-Taal-Visitor per call, plays unapproved
method.note: timings and copy.source as recorded by the session that ran the calls; no raw curl output was kept

reading: Tea: the background job had BigQuery copy ready (4.4 s at startup), so Approve took 1.3 to 2.3 s. Chips: its background call did not finish in time, so templates shipped. The pre-generated fixture (batch 2) removes that dependency for all 7 seeded plays.
